summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The 41 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the prepared interpreter. Nothing was committed and no existing file changed. Not verified: mypy, black, ruff, and isort are not in the venv, so type-ignore placement was checked by reading only. I put type-ignore[operator] only on bare-IRI multiplications, not on the /, |, or ~ operators; if mypy reports those, the type check will fail.
